pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: app/api/intake/[id]/message/route.ts:99 Each intake request runs one model exchange through a per-request Python spawn (runIntakeExchange) and writes the transcript with a compare-and-swap. The routes have no multi-call agent loop, hook chain, extension loading or checkpoint store. A search of app/api/apply and app/api/intake found no hits for checkpoint, subagent, toolCall, tool_call or plugin.

pairs.evidence: app/features/shell/tasks/TasksProvider.tsx:62 This context is a React panel that polls the task ledger over HTTP and renders it. A search of app/features/shell/tasks found no hits for checkpoint, subagent, toolCall, tool_call or plugin; the only 'hook' hits are React hooks.
